title: Power Apps: form fill assistance adds lookup, rich text and multi-select choice fields
summary: The briefing distinguishes the planned field expansion from today's documented behaviour and accurately reports the roadmap, licensing and controls. The app-designer route is supported across the cited pages, with only the more-options step omitted.

claims.claim: Microsoft plans to expand Power Apps model-driven form fill assistance to lookup fields.
claims.quote: We’re expanding form fill assistance in model-driven applications in Power Apps to support lookup, rich text, and multi-select choice fields

claims.quote: support lookup, rich text, and multi-select choice fields, helping users complete more of their forms with AI-powered suggestions and less manual entry.
